title: Batch 2: narrow-screen overflow traced to hero and community heading
summary: The hero copy fix alone did not eliminate page overflow. The Ecomedia heading also forced a 345px implicit grid track. Candidate now constrains that grid and reduces its heading only below 375px.

changes.detail: Shrinkable hero copy, fluid mobile headline, wrapping CTAs; explicit single-column community grid, shrinkable children and 32px heading below 375px.

validation.name: Root cause isolation
validation.detail: Live 320px document measured 365px; hero fixed in browser but community grid still overflowed. Unclipped ancestor probe identifies Ecomedia heading.
